# db-20 — Trial Stryker.NET mutation testing in place of hand-run mutations

Implementers in the DataBall relays mutate code by hand to prove each new test can fail: 79 mutations in db-09 round 1, 107 in db-10 round 1, 42 in a later round. This is slow model work, and in db-10 the implementer's mutation evidence could not be checked at all. Stryker.NET does mutation testing mechanically and writes a report that reviewers can read. This item is a trial on one recent slice's tests, to decide whether it replaces hand-run mutations in the relay.

**Owner gate:** Stryker.NET would be a new dev tool (a dotnet tool). The global rules require owner approval for any new dependency, and approval must come before installing anything. The licence (believed to be Apache-2.0) must be confirmed first.

**Findings:** DataBall relays db-07 to db-10, owner 2026-10-10 · **Size:** M `[OWNER]` · **Tree:** databall

**Not in this slice:** changing the relay playbook (follow-up if the trial succeeds); CI integration.

## Why

Owner, 2026-10-10: offload model work to deterministic tools wherever possible. Hand mutation costs implementer tokens every round, and its evidence is only as reliable as the implementer's report.
